create_conlluposdatasource_from_config: create a CoNLLUPOSDataSource instance from a Config object with train, test, and eval filenames
read_conllu_file_for_pos: read a CoNLL-U formatted file and yield word lists with POS tags per sentence
iterate_raw_train_data: iterate over raw training data sentences yielded by the CoNLLUPOSDataSource generator
create_conllunersource_for_ner: create a CoNLLUNERDataSource to read word-label pairs from tab-separated NER dataset files
iterate_conllunerfile_with_lock: iterate over a CoNLLUNERFile with thread-safe locking to yield word and NER label pairs
